details: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, Situational Awareness, has sold most of its public stock portfolio to Ken Griffin's Citadel. This move follows significant losses suffered by the fund due to a downturn in AI-linked stocks. The fund, which had substantial investments in AI infrastructure and Bitcoin miners, saw its assets decline sharply in July.
title: AI-Focused Fund Situational Awareness Sells Portfolio to Citadel Amid Losses

details: The European Union has sanctioned the crypto exchange HTX (formerly Huobi) as part of its latest measures against Russia, alleging the platform aided in evading financial sanctions. In a separate development, crypto exchange BitMEX has announced its permanent shutdown, effective September 23, 2026, after 11 years of operation.
title: EU Sanctions HTX Over Russia Ties; BitMEX Announces Closure

details: The U.S. Treasury Department has imposed sanctions on two Iranian maritime organizations, Persian Gulf Marine Insurance Company and HormuzSafe Marine Services Authority. These entities are accused of utilizing a crypto-based gambling network to funnel $4 billion and bypass international sanctions. Dubai regulators have also taken enforcement action against Shelbit, a crypto exchange implicated in the illicit activities.
title: US Sanctions Iran Over $4B Crypto Money Laundering Network

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) published an analysis on July 31, 2026, indicating that surging fuel prices, driven by the Middle East conflict, are significantly contributing to euro area energy inflation. Brent crude's substantial rise pushed euro area CPI to 3.2% in May 2026, exceeding the ECB's 2% target and leading to a rate hike in June. ECB officials are concerned that persistent high oil prices could further escalate inflation.
title: ECB Examines Surging Fuel Prices Amid Mideast Conflict, Inflation Risks

details: Coinbase Global announced its third consecutive quarterly loss on Thursday, July 30, 2026. The digital-asset exchange attributed this to a prolonged downturn in cryptocurrency markets, which significantly reduced its trading volumes. The company's transaction revenue fell 21% to $599 million, and its shares dropped 5.3% after the announcement.
title: Coinbase Reports Third Consecutive Quarterly Loss Amid Trading Slowdown

details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded substantial net inflows of $233 million on July 30, 2026, effectively ending a four-day streak of outflows. BlackRock's IBIT ETF was a significant contributor, leading with $183 million in inflows. This development highlights a renewed institutional interest and a clear preference for Bitcoin among major asset managers. Spot Ethereum ETFs, by comparison, saw more modest inflows of $13 million on the same day.
title: Bitcoin Spot ETFs See $233M Inflows, BlackRock Dominates

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, a crucial piece of proposed US crypto legislation, has reportedly been tabled by the Senate until after the upcoming August recess. Despite bipartisan efforts to advance the bill and incorporate ethics provisions, a crowded legislative calendar and ongoing political disagreements have hindered its immediate progress, prolonging regulatory uncertainty for the cryptocurrency industry in the United States.
title: US Clarity Act Stalls in Senate, Regulatory Uncertainty Persists

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) concluded its 2026 Article IV Consultation with Iceland, noting that despite tight macroeconomic policies, wage growth and inflation remain elevated. The IMF forecasts continued high inflation through 2026 and 2027, with risks to economic growth leaning towards the downside and inflation risks to the upside. This suggests the need for sustained tight monetary policies.
title: IMF Cautions Iceland on Elevated Inflation and Downside Risks
